Modal

Modals present critical content and actions in a focused overlay while blocking interaction with the page beneath.

Basic Modal

Open a modal with the data-zak-modal attribute on any trigger. Close it with data-zak-modal-close buttons or by clicking the backdrop. Press Escape to dismiss.

Modal Title

This is a basic modal. It has a header, body and a close button in the top-right corner.

HTML
<button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-modal="#basicModal">Open Modal</button>

<div class="zak-modal" id="basicModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="basicModalTitle">
    <div class="zak-modal-dialog">
        <div class="zak-modal-content">
            <div class="zak-modal-header">
                <h3 class="zak-modal-title" id="basicModalTitle">Modal Title</h3>
                <button type="button" class="zak-modal-close" data-zak-modal-close aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div class="zak-modal-body">
                <p style="margin:0; font-size:14px; color:var(--zak-text-muted);">This is a basic modal.</p>
            </div>
            <div class="zak-modal-footer">
                <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-secondary" data-zak-modal-close>Cancel</button>
                <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" data-zak-modal-close>Save changes</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Modal Sizes

Use .zak-modal-sm, .zak-modal-lg, .zak-modal-xl or .zak-modal-fullscreen on the dialog to change the size. The default (no class) is medium.

Small Modal

A compact modal for short confirmations.

Medium Modal

The default modal size, good for most use cases.

Large Modal

A wider modal for content-rich dialogs such as settings panels.

Extra Large Modal

Use the extra large size for dashboards, editors and reports.

HTML
<div class="zak-modal-dialog zak-modal-sm"> <!-- Small: 24rem -->
<div class="zak-modal-dialog">                     <!-- Medium: 32rem (default) -->
<div class="zak-modal-dialog zak-modal-lg">        <!-- Large: 48rem -->
<div class="zak-modal-dialog zak-modal-xl">        <!-- Extra large: 64rem -->
<div class="zak-modal-dialog zak-modal-fullscreen"> <!-- Fullscreen -->

Modal with Close Button

The .zak-modal-close button in the header dismisses the modal. Any element with data-zak-modal-close inside the modal will close it.

Dismissible Modal

Click the X, press Escape, or click the backdrop to close this modal.

Modal with Form

Forms inside modals use the standard ZAKUIKit form classes. The library focuses the first focusable element when the modal opens.

Create Account

HTML
<div class="zak-modal" id="formModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
    <div class="zak-modal-dialog">
        <div class="zak-modal-content">
            <div class="zak-modal-header">
                <h3 class="zak-modal-title">Create Account</h3>
                <button type="button" class="zak-modal-close" data-zak-modal-close aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div class="zak-modal-body">
                <form class="zak-form">
                    <div class="zak-form-group">
                        <label class="zak-form-label" for="accEmail">Email address</label>
                        <input type="email" id="accEmail" class="zak-input" placeholder="ada@example.com">
                    </div>
                </form>
            </div>
            <div class="zak-modal-footer">
                <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-secondary" data-zak-modal-close>Cancel</button>
                <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary" type="submit">Create account</button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

Centered Modal

Modals are vertically and horizontally centered by default. The dialog has a subtle scale + translateY entrance animation.

Centered

This modal is perfectly centered on the viewport. To pin it to the top instead, add align-items: flex-start to the .zak-modal element.

Scrollable Modal

When the body content grows taller than the viewport, the modal body scrolls independently while the header and footer stay fixed.

Fullscreen Modal

The .zak-modal-fullscreen class makes the dialog fill the entire viewport. It removes the border radius and the outer padding.

Fullscreen Editor

A fullscreen modal is useful for immersive tasks like writing, diagramming or reviewing media.

Static Backdrop

A static backdrop keeps the modal open when you click outside, forcing the user to interact with the dialog itself. The demo below replaces the backdrop after opening so clicks on it are ignored.

Important Notice

This modal cannot be dismissed by clicking the backdrop. Use the close button or press Escape.

CSS Classes & Variables

The modal is controlled through these CSS custom properties and classes.

HTML
/* CSS Variables */
--zak-z-backdrop: 1040;
--zak-z-modal:    1050;
--zak-backdrop-bg: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);

/* Class Summary */
.zak-modal             /* Full-screen flex container (hidden by default) */
.zak-modal-active      /* Added by JS to show the modal */
.zak-modal-backdrop    /* Fading backdrop behind the dialog */
.zak-modal-dialog      /* Centered width container (32rem default) */
.zak-modal-content     /* Surface panel with radius, border and shadow */
.zak-modal-header      /* Title bar with border */
.zak-modal-title       /* Typography for the header title */
.zak-modal-close       /* Ghost close button */
.zak-modal-body        /* Scrollable content area */
.zak-modal-footer      /* Action row with border */
.zak-modal-sm          /* 24rem  */
.zak-modal-lg          /* 48rem  */
.zak-modal-xl          /* 64rem  */
.zak-modal-fullscreen  /* 100vw x 100vh, radius 0 */

JavaScript

The data attributes wire up automatically on DOM ready. Programmatic control is also available.

HTML
// Data attributes (automatic)
//   data-zak-modal="#id"       open the modal
//   data-zak-modal-close       close the closest .zak-modal

// Programmatic API
zak.modal.open('#myModal');     // open by selector
zak.modal.close('#myModal');    // close by selector or element
zak.modal.toggle('#myModal');   // toggle

// Events
document.querySelector('.zak-modal').addEventListener('zak:open', function (e) {
    console.log('Modal opened');
});
document.querySelector('.zak-modal').addEventListener('zak:close', function (e) {
    console.log('Modal closed');
});

// Static backdrop example used in this page
document.getElementById('staticBackdropBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    zak.modal.open('#staticModal');
    var modal = document.getElementById('staticModal');
    var backdrop = modal._backdrop;
    if (backdrop) {
        var fresh = backdrop.cloneNode(true);   // clone has no close listener
        backdrop.parentNode.replaceChild(fresh, backdrop);
        modal._backdrop = fresh;
    }
});

Accessibility

Follow these best practices when building modals.

  • Add role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" to the .zak-modal container.
  • Tie the title to the dialog with aria-labelledby="#titleId" (and optionally aria-describedby for a description).
  • The library contains a focus trap: focus cycles inside the modal and returns to the trigger on close.
  • Pressing Escape closes the modal and restores page scroll.
  • Give the close button an aria-label="Close" so screen readers announce it instead of reading the × character.
  • Lock body scroll while the modal is open (the library sets overflow: hidden on the body).
  • Delay any focus-sensitive content with inert on the page behind the modal when possible.
HTML
<div class="zak-modal" id="a11yModal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true"
     aria-labelledby="a11yTitle" aria-describedby="a11yDesc">
    <div class="zak-modal-dialog">
        <div class="zak-modal-content">
            <div class="zak-modal-header">
                <h3 class="zak-modal-title" id="a11yTitle">Accessible Modal</h3>
                <button type="button" class="zak-modal-close" data-zak-modal-close aria-label="Close">&times;</button>
            </div>
            <div class="zak-modal-body">
                <p id="a11yDesc">Descriptive text that explains the dialog purpose.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
